title: Seohee Lee — weekly creative-inspo roundup, ep. 3
note: Five saves from her week. The two logged as fits for her art account, in one person, one room, zero props: Yayoi Kusama's repeated-text piece — a figure built entirely from repeated handwriting, in her own hand — and a hand-written sticky-note post as a repeatable, zero-prop format. The other three (toaster invitation, jewelry BTS, perfume flat-lay) were noted only, not steals.
